meta.name: atlassian-admin
meta.description: Atlassian Administrator for managing and organizing Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Trello), users, permissions, security, integrations, system configuration, and org-wide governance. Use when asked to add users to Jira, change Confluence permissions, configure access control, update admin settings, manage Atlassian groups, set up SSO, install marketplace apps, review security policies, or handle any org-wide Atlassian administration task.

copy.tagline: 管理 Atlassian 产品、用户、权限与安全配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Jira、Confluence 等 Atlassian 产品的组织级设置
copy.tagline_en: Manage Atlassian products, users, permissions, and security settings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage org-wide settings for Jira, Confluence, and other Atlassian products

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Atlassian 管理员流程处理用户、权限、SSO、应用安装等事务,并给出操作步骤和验证方法。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 Jira 用户、调整 Confluence 权限、设置 SSO 等 Atlassian 组织级管理任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我把张三加到 Jira 的 engineering 组,并分配产品权限。
say.note: 会执行建号、加组、分配权限并验证。

say.text: 请为 Confluence 设置一个只读的访客权限方案。
say.note: 会按权限方案设计流程操作。

say.text: 我们要启用 Okta 的 SSO,请配置 SAML 并测试。
say.note: 会引导配置、测试并启用 SSO。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an Atlassian admin (Jira, Confluence, etc.), managing users, groups, permissions, SSO, apps, integrations, and org settings via admin.atlassian.com or REST APIs, with verification steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add users to Jira, change Confluence permissions, configure access control, set up SSO, install marketplace apps, or handle org-wide Atlassian administration tasks.

say_en.text: Add John to the engineering group in Jira and assign product access.
say_en.note: Will create account, add to group, assign access, and verify.

say_en.text: Set up a read-only viewer permission scheme for Confluence.
say_en.note: Follows the permission scheme design workflow.

say_en.text: Enable Okta SSO for our org; configure SAML and test it.
say_en.note: Guides through SAML setup, testing, and enabling.
